R0266.title: Parcel Weight Shaving
R0266.definition: Couriers or sites under- or over-record weight at pickup entry, distorting billed weight to skim differentials.
R0266.description:
Parcel weight shaving occurs when couriers or sites deliberately under-record (shave) or over-record weight at pickup and entry, distorting billed weight to skim billing differentials or withhold freight, common in weight-based billing.

The risk causes billing-differential losses for platforms and merchants and distorts billed-weight and freight data. Detection must combine weighing tamper-proofing, weight-goods linkage, and targeted inspection for verification and accountability.
R0266.influence: Weight shaving causes billing-differential losses and freight withholding, distorts billed-weight data, and may trigger merchant settlement disputes.

references.title: Outlet Underweights Parcels to Evade Express Fees (Ping'an Zhejiang, Underweight Fraud)

observables: Chargeable weight at pickup weighing and entry mismatches actual goods
Under-weighing or under-recording causes billing differences to be farmed
Over-weighing or over-recording causes shipping fees to be skimmed
Weighing tamper-proofing is missing or bypassed
Anomalous weighing concentrates on specific couriers or stations with high targeted-inspection hit rates
